items.title: Interview with a shrimp
items.content_html:
Woah! One giant shrimp?!

I couldn't believe my eyes when I saw him. A Shrimp?!

He's just so large?!

But why, why does this shrimp have so much aura... 
it scares me...

items.title: A spilled can of soda
items.content_html:
Oh no! It spilled

Tip

My soda... All over the floor :(

I just opened it too... and now it's gone

How can I drink it? 
Should I get a straw and slurp it off the floor...

Haha, you clicked on this and there wasn't actually anything to read! ... Please get me more soda :(
